answer: LIST street, city, zip, state FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO has SchoolStreet street AND ALSO has SchoolCity city AND ALSO has SchoolZip zip AND ALSO has SchoolState state WHERE t > 0 ORDERED WITH g/t ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n, e FROM Frpm [has SchoolSOCType: 'State Special Schools'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST g FROM School has SchoolGSoffered g AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lo ORDERED WITH lo DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, doc FROM Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType doc AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a WHERE (k - a) > (THE AVERAGE k2 IN Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2) - (THE AVERAGE a2 IN Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2)
LIST n FROM School has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO Frpm has FrpmPercentEligibleFreeK12 p AND ALSO Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g WHERE p > 0.1 AND g > 0
LIST c, t FROM School e [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF e GROUPED BY c AS t WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH t DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
